the screen: x 34, y 101, 123 × 164 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.4391 (spec 0.4414), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://cdn.nieuwemobiel.nl/media/201006_cedar_silver_front/201006_cedar_silver_front-b2b5f849.webp (newmobile.com press set, reflection cropped off, white margin added)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://cdn.nieuwemobiel.nl/media/201006_cedar_silver_front/201006_cedar_silver_front-b2b5f849.webp); specs: [gsmarena.com](https://www.gsmarena.com/sony_ericsson_cedar-3404.php), [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/cedar/).
